description: Documents how Player & Stuff data is stored in the savedFile format

playfabID.description: The player's unique PlayFab ID string.

currentTier.description: Integer — the tier the player currently has selected.

leagueID.description: Integer — the tournament league the player is currently in.

disableAdsUnlockedBool.description: Boolean — true if the player has purchased the ad removal pack.

starterPackUnlockedBool.description: Boolean — true if the player has purchased the starter pack (one-time coin multiplier boost).

epicPackUnlockedBool.description: Boolean — true if the player has purchased the epic pack (one-time coin multiplier boost).

highestWaveThisTier.description: Integer list — highest wave reached per tier. Index corresponds to tier number. Index 0 is always 0 (no tier 0). Tiers whose wave is <= 0 are skipped entirely. The parser keeps the raw uncapped wave; capping is a display/import choice made in the front end.
highestWaveThisTier.capBehaviour: The save-file UI holds a per-user preference (user property SAVE_FILE_PLAYER_WAVES_AT_CAP, default true) deciding whether a wave above the 4500 milestone cap is shown/imported clamped to 4500 or as the true highest wave reached. See getSaveFilePlayerWaveCapPreference / setSaveFilePlayerWaveCapPreference.

milestonesPremiumUnlocked.description: Boolean list — whether the premium milestone pass is unlocked for a tier group. Each index covers 3 tiers: index 0 covers tiers 1-3, index 1 covers tiers 4-6, etc.

dissonanceDamageBoost.description: Integer list — attack dissonance bonus multiplier per tier. Index 0 is always 0 (no tier 0). Caps at 5000.

dissonanceHealthBoost.description: Integer list — health dissonance bonus multiplier per tier. Index 0 is always 0 (no tier 0). Caps at 5000.

dissonanceCoinBoost.description: Integer list — coin dissonance bonus multiplier per tier. Index 0 is always 0 (no tier 0). Caps at 5000.

dissonanceUltDamageBoost.description: Integer list — ultimate weapon dissonance bonus multiplier per tier. Index 0 is always 0 (no tier 0). Caps at 5000.

totalCoinsEarned.description: Number — lifetime coins earned. Rendered with the suffix formatter (see lifetimeValueFormat).

totalStonesEarned.description: Number — lifetime stones earned. Summed with totalStonesBought to produce the 'Stones' stat.

totalStonesBought.description: Number — lifetime stones purchased. Summed with totalStonesEarned to produce the 'Stones' stat.

totalGemsEarned.description: Number — lifetime gems earned. Summed with totalGemsBought to produce the 'Gems' stat.

totalGemsBought.description: Number — lifetime gems purchased. Summed with totalGemsEarned to produce the 'Gems' stat.

totalKeysEarned.description: Number — lifetime keys earned. Rendered with the suffix formatter.

battleHistory.description: Array of past run records. Only coinsEarned and realTime are read, to derive the 'Coin / Hour' stat.

usedFields.coinsEarned: number — coins earned in that run

derivedStats.description: Values computed by parsePlayerStuffData rather than read straight from a save key. These populate the 'Stat' block; statOrder in the returned payload lists them in this order.
derivedStats.Tourney League: leagueID mapped through the league values table; null when leagueID is falsy
derivedStats.Coin / Hour: Mean coins-per-hour over the 3 best runs in battleHistory. Each run contributes coinsEarned / (realTime / 3600); runs missing either field are dropped, the list is sorted descending, and the top 3 (or fewer) are averaged. null when no run qualifies.

premiumPacks.description: The 'Premium Packs' block, emitted alongside the Stat block. premiumOrder in the returned payload lists these keys.

lifetimeValueFormat.description: Large lifetime totals are abbreviated to 2 decimal places with a power-of-1000 suffix. Values below 1000 are printed as-is (rounded to 2 dp) with no suffix.
lifetimeValueFormat.beyondD: Groups past 'D' continue as two-letter suffixes: aa, ab, ac, ... (group 12 → 'aa').
